n = int(input())
base = int(input())

digits = []
while n > 0:
    digits.append(n % base)
    n //= base
digits.reverse()

MAXK = 31
MOD = 1000000007

def make_identity(size):
    I = [[0]*(size+1) for _ in range(size+1)]
    for i in range(size+1):
        I[i][i] = 1
    return I

def matrix_product(A, B, size):
    C = [[0]*(size+1) for _ in range(size+1)]
    for i in range(size+1):
        for k in range(size+1):
            for j in range(size+1):
                C[i][j] = (C[i][j] + A[i][k] * B[k][j]) % MOD
    return C

def setup_matrices():
    A_matrices = [[[ [0]*(MAXK+1) for _ in range(MAXK+1)] for _ in range(base)] for _ in range(len(digits))]
    pre = [[[0]*(MAXK+1) for _ in range(MAXK+1)] for _ in range(len(digits))]
    suf = [[[0]*(MAXK+1) for _ in range(MAXK+1)] for _ in range(len(digits))]
    I = make_identity(MAXK)
    # Initialize A[0]
    for i in range(base):
        for j in range(base+1):
            for k in range(base+1):
                A_matrices[0][i][j][k] = 0
        A_matrices[0][i][i][0] = 1
        A_matrices[0][i][i][i+1] = 1  # Adjusted to match the original logic
    # Build matrices for subsequent digits
    for i in range(1, len(digits)):
        prev_A = A_matrices[i-1]
        # pre[0]
        for j in range(base+1):
            for k in range(base+1):
                pre[i][0][j][k] = prev_A[0][j][k]
        # pre[j]
        for j in range(1, base):
            pre[i][j] = matrix_product(prev_A[j], pre[i][j-1], MAXK)
        # suf[base-1]
        for j in range(base+1):
            for k in range(base+1):
                suf[i][base-1][j][k] = prev_A[base-1][j][k]
        # suf[j]
        for j in range(base-2, -1, -1):
            suf[i][j] = matrix_product(suf[i][j+1], prev_A[j], MAXK)
        # A[i][j]
        for j in range(base):
            if j > 0:
                A_matrices[i][j] = matrix_product(pre[i][j-1], suf[i][j], MAXK)
            else:
                A_matrices[i][j] = matrix_product(I, suf[i][j], MAXK)
    return A_matrices

A = setup_matrices()

answer = [[0]*(MAXK+1) for _ in range(MAXK+1)]
for i in range(base+1):
    answer[i][0] = 1 if i == 0 else 0

x = 0
for i in range(len(digits)-1, -1, -1):
    for j in range(digits[i]):
        answer = matrix_product(A[i][(j + x) % base], answer, MAXK)
    x = (x + digits[i]) % base

res = 0
for i in range(base):
    res = (res + answer[i][0]) % MOD

print(res + 1)
